/**
 * ====================================================================
 * MEMORIES PHOTO COLLECTION (20 Frames with Stories & Captions)
 * ====================================================================
 * Each memory includes:

 * - story: An intimate, heartfelt sentence revealed upon single-tap
 * - tag, date, aspect, width, objectPosition
 */

export const memories = [
  {
    id: 1,
    image: "/images/photo1.jpg",
    caption: "The look on your face right before another burst of laughter.",
    story: "I still smile whenever I think about this day. Some moments just feel like pure sunshine.",
    tag: "Pure Joy",
    date: "A quiet moment",
    rotation: -2.2,
    yOffset: -8,
    scale: 1.02,
    aspect: "4/5",
    width: "280px",
    objectPosition: "center 20%",
  },
  {
    id: 2,
    image: "/images/photo2.jpg",
    caption: "A spontaneous snapshot that became an instant favorite memory.",
    story: "We didn't plan this at all, but the best memories are always the unplanned ones.",

    date: "Golden hours",
    rotation: 1.8,
    yOffset: 10,

  {

    rotation: -2.8,
    yOffset: -10,

    rotation: 1.6,

  {

  {

    tag: "Cherished",
    date: "Late evening",
    rotation: 2.1,
    yOffset: 6,
    scale: 0.97,
    aspect: "4/5",
    width: "275px",
    objectPosition: "center 20%",

  {

    yOffset: 8,
    scale: 0.98,
    aspect: "3/4",
    width: "280px",
    objectPosition: "center 20%",
  },
  {
    id: 13,
    image: "/images/photo13.jpg",
    caption: "A road trip that turned into one of our all-time favorite stories.",
    story: "Music blasting on repeat, wind in our hair, and nonstop laughing.",
    tag: "Wanderlust",
    date: "Open roads",
    rotation: -1.7,
    yOffset: -6,
    scale: 1.01,
    aspect: "3/4",
    width: "275px",
    objectPosition: "center 20%",
  },
  {
    id: 14,
    image: "/images/photo14.jpg",
    caption: "Capturing the little candid moments where you were just being you.",
    story: "Real, unguarded, and full of natural charm. This is one of my absolute favorites.",
    tag: "Candid",
    date: "Candid smiles",
    rotation: 2.5,
    yOffset: 12,
    scale: 0.96,
    aspect: "9/16",
    width: "260px",
    objectPosition: "center 20%",

  {

    scale: 1.03,
    aspect: "3/4",
    width: "285px",
    objectPosition: "center 20%",

  {
    id: 16,
    image: "/images/photo16.jpg",

    image: "/images/photo17.jpg",
    caption: "That genuine happiness reflected in the gentlest of glances.",

    date: "Afternoon light",
    rotation: -1.8,
    yOffset: -12,
    scale: 1.02,
    aspect: "3/4",
    width: "280px",
    objectPosition: "center 20%",
  },
  {
    id: 18,
    image: "/images/photo18.jpg",
    caption: "Cozy afternoon with favorite music playing softly in the background.",
    story: "Cold coffee, warm hearts, and conversation that flowed for hours.",
    tag: "Cozy Days",
    date: "Peaceful hours",
    rotation: 2.7,
    yOffset: 10,
    scale: 0.98,
    aspect: "4/5",
    width: "275px",
    objectPosition: "center 20%",
  },

    id: 19,
    image: "/images/photo19.jpg",
    caption: "A timeless memory frozen in golden, heartwarming light.",
    story: "A quiet moment that felt like a movie scene come to life.",
    tag: "Timeless",
    date: "Golden hour",
    rotation: -2.3,
    yOffset: -8,
    scale: 1.02,
    aspect: "3/4",
    width: "280px",
    objectPosition: "center 20%",
  },
  {
    id: 20,
    image: "/images/photo20.jpg",
    caption: "May this year bring you all the love and happiness you bring to others.",
    story: "You deserve the very best year ahead. Always cheering for you.",
    tag: "Birthday Wish",
    date: "October Special",
    rotation: 1.9,
    yOffset: 8,
    scale: 1.01,
    aspect: "3/4",
    width: "285px",
    objectPosition: "center 20%",
  },
];
